preset.text:
Two cards appear in the center — an orange DESCRIPTOR and a blue CATEGORY of people. Shout out a real person or character who fits BOTH!

The FIRST player to shout out an answer that the group approves of can then click either card in the center to claim their point. You have 30 seconds per round. Go fast!

Some cards are wildcards - in this case, only the other card is relevant. If both cards are wildcards, be the first to shout out anything first!

preset.title: PLAY AGAIN?
preset.question: Would you like to play another round?
